behaviors.description: The application restores vegetation state before preparing the planet scene and saves it atomically on close. Water and audio have independent explicit lifetimes; failure cleanup runs before native scene destruction. Existing invalid or legacy vegetation saves are preserved.
behaviors.selection: Planet-surface application with the corresponding enabled Systems.

checks.expectation: A successful close retains plant growth and damage and releases water/audio/scene resources. A rejected save load cannot be overwritten by shutdown.
checks.procedure: Inspect and exercise normal and partial-startup cleanup, save write failures, stale snapshot versions and repeated open/close separately; source edits do not establish device correctness.

behaviors.description: The front-of-house computer locks the player at the current observer pose and focuses the shared workstation on its physical display. E or Escape returns to the preserved game; headsets retain immersive entry.
behaviors.selection: Left-click the physical screen within four metres with macOS baked WebGPU. DAW only mode remains an independent diagnostic path.

checks.expectation: Entering/exiting/reopening preserves game Entity, player pose, texture, document, panel motion and audio lifetime. Failed workstation preparation restores the game. Native presentation is recreated because render pipelines are selected at construction.
checks.procedure: Run computer_focus_preserves_game_texture_document_and_workstation_layout and failed_computer_presentation_can_restore_and_retry_retained_game; verify native click, Escape, failed assets, window close and mobile gesture mode separately.

behaviors.description: The explicit finite benchmark locates the authored theatre computer and reuses the production game suspend, embedded workstation, and game restore transition. It selects physical computer, AR, VR or security-camera observers, validates embedded geometry and retains measured timing before cleanup.
behaviors.selection: Only --benchmark-game-workstation; ordinary gameplay and DAW-only entry are unchanged.

checks.expectation: A completed capture has a real computer, embedded camera geometry, drawn measured frames, correct DAW GPU category and zero remaining entities. User preferences and the installed app remain untouched.
checks.procedure: Run explicit_bounded_combined_entry and ordinary_entries_remain_distinct, then the guarded finite combined benchmark; inspect actual mode, GPU source, frame timing and cleanup evidence.

checks.expectation: The serial suite distinguishes physical computer, real AR/VR pairs, standalone DAW and normal game. DAW replay uses monotonic elapsed-time input, VR observer motion uses normal navigation without diagnostic rays, and reports reject wrong modes, fixed-step motion, interrupted draws and incomplete audio counters.
checks.procedure: Run python3 -m unittest discover -s BuildSupport/Workstation -p test_benchmark_modes.py; build a fresh app and run BuildSupport/Workstation/benchmark_modes.py --app APP. Inspect all modes, observer metadata, actual VR positions, moving-frame timing, GPU query coverage and cleanup. Game-only audio lifetime counters are not measured-window deltas.
